dct_description_sm: The Regional Municipality of Durham, Planning and Economic Development Department and its municipal partners conduct an annual count of businesses within the Region. Between May and September, the Region's Business Count team visit every business establishment in Durham to gather basic information about the type and nature of the business, the number of employees, floor space, etc. The success of this important survey depends upon the assistance and co-operating of the region's business community.
